cli.archmeld review-diff --freeze --persist: copy changed/added candidate bytes into the CAS, pin objects, and persist the report
cli.constraints: workspace mode only; requires --persist; bounded to 500 files / 64 MiB

output.provenance.candidate.durable: true only when every changed/added file was frozen, digest-matched, and not truncated

invariants.history_mutation: review report and object pins only, explicit opt-in
